thread.title: Rep. Ugaste introduces bill for litigation financing transparency in Illinois
thread.title_full: Rep. Ugaste introduces bill for litigation financing transparency in Illinois

author: V. M. Drummond
title: Rep. Ugaste introduces bill for litigation financing transparency in Illinois
text:
Illinois State Representative Dan Ugaste has introduced a bill aimed at increasing transparency in the third-party lawsuit investing industry. The proposed legislation, HB5244, would establish the Illinois Litigation Financing Transparency Act.
Ugaste stated, “Illinois’ courts should be fair, transparent, and accountable. That’s why Illinois lawmakers should pass HB5244, a bill I filed that creates the Illinois Litigation Financing Transparency Act. This legislation helps regulate and bring transparency to the fast-growing industry of Third-Party Lawsuit Investing.”
Ugaste is a Republican who was elected to represent the 65th House District in 2019, succeeding Steven Andersson.
The bill comes as attention grows around the practice of third-party funding in lawsuits, which allows outside investors to finance legal cases in exchange for a share of any potential award or settlement. Supporters argue that regulation will provide oversight and accountability within this sector.
For more information on third-party lawsuit investing and legislative efforts surrounding it, visit Cook County Record.
